description: One line by post that mentions a DOI format.
dataset_description: Mentions of scientific works (identified by DOI) in public Bluesky posts. Each row represents a single public post containing a DOI. The table is compatible with OpenAlex through the `doi_url` field, which follows the OpenAlex DOI URL format. The data was collected from a public snapshot on June 26, 2026, using the Bluesky Search API and Firehose.

schema.name: citation_id
schema.description: Stable identifier for the record (one post occurrence mentioning a DOI)

schema.name: doi
schema.description: Normalized lowercase DOI, with trailing punctuation and URL artifacts removed. Universal join key

schema.name: doi_raw
schema.description: DOI preserved exactly as it was extracted from the post.

schema.name: doi_url
schema.description: DOI represented as a URL (https://doi.org/<doi>). Convenience field for joining with datasets that store DOIs in URL format.

schema.name: doi_prefix
schema.description: DOI prefix (e.g., 10.1038), identifying the publisher or DOI registrant.

schema.name: arxiv_id
schema.description: arXiv identifier extracted from URLs in the post, when available.

schema.name: pmid
schema.description: PubMed ID extracted from URLs in the post, when available.

schema.name: pmc_id
schema.description: Europe PMC ID extracted from URLs in the post, when available.

schema.name: posted_at
schema.description: Timestamp when the post was published (createdAt from the AT Protocol record, in UTC). This is not the data collection timestamp.

schema.name: posted_at_raw
schema.description: Original createdAt value

schema.name: author_did
schema.description: Decentralized Identifier (DID) of the Bluesky post author.

schema.name: author_handle
schema.description: Author's handle (e.g., user.bsky.social) at the time of data collection. This value may change over time.

schema.name: post_text
schema.description: Full text of the post. Retained for auditing and to provide context for the DOI mention.

schema.name: source_urls
schema.description: URLs extracted from the post's facets, separated by the pipe (|) character. Used to recover the complete DOI when it was truncated in the post text.

description: A table containing DOI citations extracted from Wikipedia articles in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, based on a snapshot from approximately May 2026. It links scientific works to the Wikipedia pages in which they are cited, using the DOI as the join key. A normalized doi_url field compatible with the OpenAlex format is also included.
dataset_description: A dataset containing DOI citations extracted from Wikipedia articles in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, based on a snapshot from April 2026. It links scientific works to the Wikipedia pages in which they are cited, using the DOI as the join key. A normalized doi_url field compatible with the OpenAlex format is also included.

schema.name: ref_id
schema.description: Stable identifier for each <ref> occurrence (i.e., each citation). One-to-one join key with work_citations_raw.

schema.name: doi
schema.description: Normalized lowercase DOI, with any URL prefix and query string removed. Primary join key for SciELO, Redalyc, and Crossref.

schema.name: doi_raw
schema.description: DOI preserved exactly as it was extracted from Wikipedia. Retained for auditing and reversibility.

schema.name: doi_url
schema.description: DOI represented as a URL

schema.name: issn
schema.description: Journal ISSN, when available. Secondary key for joining with journal and source tables.

schema.name: language
schema.description: Wikipedia edition

schema.name: wiki_page_title
schema.description: Title of the Wikipedia article that cites the DOI.

schema.name: wiki_page_url
schema.description: URL of the live Wikipedia page, providing an independent reference to the article.

schema.name: cited_title
schema.description: Title of the cited work, extracted from the citation template.

schema.name: cited_author
schema.description: Authors of the cited work, extracted from the citation template.

schema.name: cited_year
schema.description: Publication year as originally extracted (string, unmodified).

schema.name: cited_year_int
schema.description: Publication year converted to an integer (NULL if non-numeric).

schema.name: cited_month
schema.description: Publication month as originally extracted (string, unmodified).

schema.name: cited_month_int
schema.description: Publication month converted to an integer (NULL if non-numeric). Convenience field.

schema.name: doi_source
schema.description: How the DOI was found in the citation

schema.name: year_confidence
schema.description: Source of the publication year

schema.name: provenance
schema.description: Record provenance
